body_lead: The Maharashtra government has approved a INR 45 crore allocation to accelerate the development of the Bhandup Bird Sanctuary, an eco-tourism project that will feature India's first artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled bird monitoring system, Mumbai Suburban Guardian Minister Ashish Shelar announced on Monday. The project will be developed along the Thane Creek shoreline near the Bhandup Pumping Station, within the Ramsar-designated Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary.
